sentences.en: On the afternoon of June 18th in the Los Angeles neighborhood of Echo Park
sentences.zh: 6月18日的下午，在洛杉矶的回声公园社区，

sentences.en: at the intersection of Sunset Boulevard and Logan Street,
sentences.zh: 在日落大道和洛根街的交叉路口，

sentences.en: people were going about their day, having brunch at trendy cafes
sentences.zh: 人们正过着日常的生活，在时髦的咖啡馆吃早午餐，

sentences.en: and perusing a local bookstore, when suddenly they saw something extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 逛着当地的书店，突然间，他们看到了非同寻常的一幕。

sentences.en: A battle between good and evil.
sentences.zh: 一场正义与邪恶的较量。

sentences.en: That's reporter and friend of the show, David Weinberg.
sentences.zh: 那是记者，也是本节目的朋友，大卫·温伯格。

sentences.en: Some of the people who saw the confrontation probably thought a movie or a commercial was being filmed.
sentences.zh: 一些目睹这场对峙的人可能以为是在拍电影或广告。

sentences.en: Why else would a guy in a superhero outfit attempt to move a car with his bare hands?
sentences.zh: 不然为什么一个穿着超级英雄装束的家伙要试图用双手去推一辆车呢？

sentences.en: It all started when a woman in a white jeep pulled up to the traffic light
sentences.zh: 这一切始于一位开着白色吉普车的女士在红绿灯前停下，

sentences.en: to make a right turn onto Sunset Boulevard.
sentences.zh: 准备右转进入日落大道。

sentences.en: Now, it's perfectly legal to make a right turn on Red in California.
sentences.zh: 在加州，红灯右转是完全合法的。

sentences.en: What you're not supposed to do is block the crosswalk while you wait your turn.
sentences.zh: 但你不应该在等待转弯时阻挡人行横道。

sentences.en: And that's exactly what happened here.
sentences.zh: 而这正是这里发生的情况。

sentences.en: It was at this precise moment that our hero emerged from the shadows to save the day.
sentences.zh: 就在这一刻，我们的英雄从阴影中现身，拯救了局面。

sentences.en: He was wearing a black and white striped cape and a mask.
sentences.zh: 他戴着面具，披着黑白条纹的斗篷。

sentences.en: This caped crusader bravely approached the front of the car,
sentences.zh: 这位披风侠勇敢地走到车头前，

sentences.en: placed his hands on the hood, and started pushing.
sentences.zh: 把手放在引擎盖上，开始推车。

sentences.en: I'm the pedestrian, luchador, vigilante of the streets, fighting for pedestrian rights.
sentences.zh: 我是行人、摔角手，也是街头的义警，为行人的权利而战。
他是一位现实生活中的超级英雄。

sentences.en: Yeah, I don't like too much the word superhero.
sentences.zh: 是的，我不太喜欢“超级英雄”这个词。
我觉得它听起来很自命不凡。

sentences.en: But I like more vigilante, or in Spanish, the word luchador.
sentences.zh: 但我更喜欢“义警”，或者用西班牙语说，叫“摔角手”。

sentences.en: That it's a fighter, a fighter of the streets.
sentences.zh: 那意味着一个斗士，一个街头的斗士。

sentences.en: It's El Piatonito models his look on Mexican wrestlers.
sentences.zh: 皮亚托尼托的造型灵感来源于墨西哥摔角手。

sentences.en: But this hero does not wage his battles in the ring.
sentences.zh: 但这位英雄并不在擂台上战斗。

sentences.en: He fights in the dangerous, smog-choked, traffic-clogged metropolises
sentences.zh: 他在危险、烟雾缭绕、交通拥堵的大都市中战斗，

sentences.en: wherever the humble pedestrian faces their most dangerous villain, the automobile.
sentences.zh: 无论卑微的行人面对他们最危险的恶棍——汽车——的地方在哪里。

sentences.en: The people of Los Angeles are very much in need of a hero like El Piatonito.
sentences.zh: 洛杉矶人民非常需要像皮亚托尼托这样的英雄。

sentences.en: Because in many ways, the city's leaders have failed to protect them from automobiles.
sentences.zh: 因为在很多方面，这座城市的领导者未能保护他们免受汽车的伤害。

sentences.en: Every 30 hours, a person in Los Angeles is killed in a car-related incident.
sentences.zh: 在洛杉矶，每30小时就有一人死于与汽车相关的事故。

sentences.en: It's the leading cause of death of children in California, car crashes.
sentences.zh: 车祸是加州儿童死亡的首要原因。

sentences.en: And all because we wanted to go fast in the streets.
sentences.zh: 而这一切仅仅是因为我们想在街道上开得快一点。

sentences.en: And the main job of the government is to protect our lives.
sentences.zh: 政府的主要职责是保护我们的生命。

sentences.en: El Piatonito is not some lone crusader fighting for us mortals.
sentences.zh: 皮亚托尼托并不是什么为我们凡人而战的孤胆英雄。

sentences.en: There are real-life superheroes all over the world, scouring the streets of their towns,
sentences.zh: 世界各地都有现实生活中的超级英雄，他们搜寻着城镇的街道，

sentences.en: doing their part to fill in the gaps where local authorities have failed.
sentences.zh: 尽自己的一份力量去填补地方当局失职留下的空白。

sentences.en: David recently made a whole podcast about real-life superheroes.
sentences.zh: 大卫最近制作了一个关于现实生活超级英雄的完整播客。

sentences.en: While working on it, I discovered a whole world of costumed vigilantes and do-gooders,
sentences.zh: 在制作过程中，我发现了一个充满变装义警和行善者的世界，

sentences.en: some of whom were hell-bent on catching criminals and getting into fights.
sentences.zh: 其中一些人一心想抓捕罪犯并卷入斗争。

sentences.en: But El Piatonito was part of a different subset of real-life superheroes,
sentences.zh: 但皮亚托尼托属于现实生活超级英雄中的另一个分支，

sentences.en: who were more focused on things like picking up trash and taking on civic issues.
sentences.zh: 他们更专注于捡垃圾和处理公民问题等事情。

sentences.en: They take their inspiration from comic books.
sentences.zh: 他们从漫画书中汲取灵感。

sentences.en: But in some ways, these real-life heroes have more ambitious goals
sentences.zh: 但在某些方面，这些现实生活中的英雄有着比打败虚构恶棍更宏大的目标。
他们致力于解决重大的社会问题。

sentences.en: They are out to solve big societal probleMs.

sentences.en: these heroes heed the call of service.
sentences.zh: 当我第一次听说现实生活中的超级英雄时，我对此持怀疑态度。

sentences.en: When I first heard about real-life superheroes, I was skeptical of them.
sentences.zh: 我想他们肯定只是想博取关注。
